decision: Add Slack as the first external team delivery-surface implementation while keeping Slack approval and Slack delivery as independently configured capabilities over the canonical DeliveryEnvelope and DeliveryReceipt boundary.
implemented_capabilities: a bundled slack delivery-surface adapter publishes approved briefs to one configured Slack channel
confirmed Slack channel and message identities become canonical delivery receipts
durable idempotency state replays confirmed deliveries and pins ambiguous outcomes without automatically posting duplicates
approval and delivery adapters share only capability-neutral Slack HTTP plumbing
architectural_invariants: Slack delivery never interprets approval reactions or reviewer identity
Slack approval never performs post-approval delivery
adapter credentials remain external references and are never copied into delivery records
a Slack API acknowledgement is required before a delivered receipt is returned
the adapter remains DEV and unqualified until supervised live delivery evidence is recorded
